title: Princeton Taiwanese American Students Association
content_html:
The Princeton Taiwanese American Students Association (TASA) is an undergraduate affinity group at Princeton University dedicated to promoting Taiwanese culture and heritage on campus. The organization was revived in 2022 after a prior iteration became inactive around 2018, and has grown into one of the more visible cultural organizations on campus. It is recognized and supported by Princeton’s Office of the Dean of Undergraduate Students (ODUS), which provides funding for student organizations to host events.

TASA’s signature annual event is the Night Market, held each spring in East Pyne Hall’s courtyard. The event brings together cultural and dance groups from across campus, with food sourced from local New Jersey restaurants, and draws hundreds of attendees. The organization also hosts smaller gatherings such as study breaks and dinners throughout the academic year. TASA has participated in collaborative events with neighboring institutions, including joint dinners with Rutgers TASA, and maintains a connection to the broader Taiwanese American community through the Intercollegiate Taiwanese American Student Association (ITASA) network.
